hypotheses.statement: Steady-state y is monotonically increasing in u: a step to u=0.3 from y~0.23 causes a sustained rise >0.05 given enough hold time.
Response has lag/inertia, not instantaneous: 63% of step response takes 30-180 s, observable as curved rise and non-zero end slope on 300 s hold if not settled.
No large dead zone: u in 0.2-0.4 produces measurable heating (>0.02 rise) rather than zero response.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward room level (~0.05-0.20) due to heat loss, rather than holding or rising.
Static gain is approximately linear across u in [0,1]: doubling u roughly doubles steady-state rise above ambient.
Steady-state input needed to hold target y=0.5 is between 0.3 and 0.7.
Sensor short-term noise is small (<0.01): trends >0.02 over 100s are real dynamics, not noise.

hypotheses.statement: Steady-state y is monotonically increasing in u pre and post but post level much lower: pre u=0.3->~0.47, u=0.4->~0.54 rising, u=0.27->0.527, u=0.26->0.483; post u=0.4->~0.40-0.44 flattening from 0.174 over 270s, u=0.55->0.496 rising toward ~0.55 after 130s.

Response has lag/inertia tau ~120-180s with short dead-time tens of s: E2 63% decay ~170s, E1/E3 still rising after 280-300s, E8 fall starts in ~16-24s, E9 rise starts in ~30-40s, E10 rise within ~6-9s of 0.4->0.55 similar to pre-change.
No large dead zone at operating levels: u=0.25 to 0.55 all produce measurable heating/holding >0.35, with ordered steady levels pre and post change.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward room level ~0.10-0.20 due to heat loss: E2 0.469 to 0.147 mean in 480s, E8 0.41 to 0.157 mean in 480s with similar curve, rather than holding.
Pre-change static gain is approximately linear with (y_ss-ambient)/u ~1.27-1.40 with ambient ~0.15: predicts ~0.49 at 0.25, ~0.49-0.50 at 0.26, ~0.53 at 0.27, ~0.57 at 0.33 as observed.
Pre-change steady-state input to hold target y=0.5 was ~0.26-0.27 centered ~0.265, because u=0.33 holds 0.571, u=0.27 holds 0.527, u=0.26 holds 0.483 in-band, u=0.25 holds 0.466-0.49 just below.
Sensor noise/outliers are substantial ~0.02-0.05 requiring averaging: E2/E3/E5/E6/E8/E9/E10 show +/-0.03 scatter and 0.04-0.08 dips, so only trends >0.05 over 100s are reliable dynamics.

Change includes weaker actuator (~45% gain reduction to K'~0.70-0.73): same u=0.4 now heads to ~0.44 vs ~0.60+ pre-change (E3 vs E9 0.174->0.406 in 270s), while u=0 cooling E8 matches E2; E10 0.417->0.496 in 130s at 0.55 implies y_ss~0.55 vs ~0.89 pre-change.

Change includes faster outflow / larger heat loss: would require faster u=0 cooling and lower ambient, but E8 final 0.157 vs E2 0.147 and similar decay shape argues against large increase; E10 rise rate also too small for faster loss alone.

Change includes slower response / larger dead-time: would require >100s flat after command change, but E8 fall starts within ~16-24s of u=0 and E9 rise within ~30-40s like pre-change, E10 responds within ~6-9s of 0.4->0.55, so delay is tens of s only.

Change includes sensor shift (offset/gain, not just noise): would shift all readings but preserve rise for +0.11 u and change scatter/ambient, but ambient ~0.15-0.16 unchanged, scatter +/-0.03 unchanged, and monitoring flat is explained by starting above new steady while u ramps.

Post-change gain K'~0.71-0.72 with ambient~0.157 implies new u* to hold 0.5 is ~0.47-0.50 (0.476 from (0.5-0.157)/0.72), vs pre 0.265; E9 y_ss(0.4)~0.44 and E10 y_ss(0.55)~0.55 bracket 0.5 but 130s hold is too short/noisy to pin within 0.02.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: New steady-state input u* to hold 0.5 after gain loss, which sets controller feedforward and integral authority to stay in 0.475-0.525 band.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case rise 0.4984 + 0.006*0.48*110 = 0.815 < 0.85 soft limit with ~0.035 margin; last u=0.55 moderate with y in-band so no hidden high in transit; u=0.48 near steady so expected flat, far from hard cutoff 0.9.
proposal.expected_observation: If weaker-gain C1/C5 (K'~0.70-0.73, ambient~0.15-0.16, tau~120-180s, u*~0.47-0.50) is right, y will hold essentially flat from ~0.498 toward ~0.50-0.51 over 110 s with slope near zero, plus +/-0.03 scatter. Continued rise toward >0.56 at ~0.0007/s would favor no gain change; fall toward <0.46 would favor faster-loss C2 or u* >0.52.
proposal.readiness_justification: Weaker actuator established and outflow/delay/sensor largely ruled out, but new u* still uncertain +-0.03 (0.47-0.53) from unsaturated 130s E10; one short in-band hold at 0.48 will discriminate flat vs rise/fall and set feedforward, acceptable to generate after.
proposal.operator_note: Holding at estimated new feedforward 0.48 to confirm flat hold at target before redesign.
